Congress Leader Demands CEC Resignation Over Accountability

Congress leader Shashi Tharoor has called for the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) to ensure accountability. Tharoor drew a parallel, asking why the CEC cannot resign if the Vice President can. Sachin Pilot also questioned the CEC's inability to resign, referring to the Prime Minister as 'Soon-to-Be Ex-PM'. The coverage also touches upon voter deletions and allegations made by the BJP against the opposition.
